subject: Error in data$H_Name : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

messages.author: d48c25039d976859
messages.subject: Error in data$H_Name : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
Can anybody tell my how come I m getting this error?

Error in data$H_Name : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

Also I need to add a drop down that will use a column from the spreadsheet as the selection of items.It currently titled statistics in the code below. I have choices as data$H_Name. H_Name is the column name from the .csv file.  How can I do this?

My code is below.

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(shinySignals)
library(shinydashboard)


header <- dashboardHeader( title = "Bsic Box Plots")
sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(
sidebarMenu(
menuItem("Graphics and Plotting", tabName = "risk", icon = icon("dashboard"))
))

body <- dashboardBody(
tabItems(
tabItem("risk",
fluidRow(
box(title = "Plot1", background = "blue"),
#selectInput("KStats", label = h3("Statistics"), choices = data$H_Name, selected = 1),
plotOutput("box")
      ))
   )
)
server <- function(input, output) {

dataInput <- reactive({
data <- read.csv("SampleData.csv")
data <- data.frame(data)

})
 
output$box <- renderPlot({
data <- dataInput()
print(data$H_Name[1])
ggplot(data, aes(x=data$H_Name, y=data$P_Speed)) + geom_boxplot(fill="lightgreen") + theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill="skyblue", color="black", size=2.5, linetype="solid"), panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA,color="black", size=2.5, linetype="solid"), panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "skyblue", size=1),
axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "indianred", face = "bold"), axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "indianred", face =
"bold"),axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "indianred", angle = 0, size = 11, face = "bold"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "indianred", angle = 45, size = 11,
face ="bold")) + theme(plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold", colour = "indianred")) + geom_jitter(aes(colour = data$P_Distance)) +
scale_colour_gradient(low="red", high="yellow") + coord_flip()
})

}
shinyApp(
ui = dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body),
server = server
)



Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Error in data$H_Name : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
I think you want to leave off the "data$" prefix when you're defining aesthetics in ggplot; simply H_Name, P_Speed, etc. is all that is needed. If ggplot2 can't resolve a symbol using a column from the data frame you gave it, by default it looks in the global environment, not the caller's environment, to find any other symbols (arguably this is a bug in ggplot2 but it's too late to fix); so it's finding utils::data, which is a function, not a data frame.

The other way to fix this is to pass envir=environment() to... either ggplot() or aes(), I can't remember which. That tells ggplot2 to do the lookup in the caller's environment instead of the global environment.
